submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when the current token completes a conventionalized local unit strongly cued by the immediately preceding 1-2 tokens: either the continuation of a split multi-token word (ochondria, -ynthesis, violin-ist) or the cued second half of a fixed collocation (at->least, greater->than, According to->the, Neil->Armstrong, stepped->out). The same surface token without its licensing left context (least after was, the after Listen to, Armstrong after young) drives little activity.
